executive_summary.text: Cost year 2024: direct care cost was $167.12 per resident day (45.2% of expenses); Connecticut median $169.07.

Cost year 2024: the home recorded $8,826,925 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 33,455 Medicaid days, $263.84 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $286.03 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $303.54 for July 2025 to June 2026.

Cost year 2024: DSS's review removed $636,573 of the $1,017,312 management fee (page 16, line m12), leaving $380,739 in the costs DSS counts. The data shows the change, not the reason; DSS caps management fees and can remove related-party charges.
Cost year 2024: nursing home operating margin was -2.8% (Connecticut median 0.5%).

Cost year 2024: dietary cost $1,304,118, $30.11 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.6). Wages $675,322 (51.8%), allocated fringe $163,148 (12.5%), non-wage costs $465,648 (35.7%). Raw food was $383,713 ($8.86 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.59).
Cost year 2024: housekeeping cost $623,000, $14.38 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.07). Wages $477,007 (76.6%), allocated fringe $115,238 (18.5%), non-wage costs $30,755 (4.9%).
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2025 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075329/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2025 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
